answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay stops bulk fakes. A newcomer joins only as a vertex sponsored by an agent staking a $40 bond, slashed on cheating. Reputation starts at 10, decays 10% each epoch without a peer-checked task logged with a quill signature. 1,000 identities need $40,000 in bonds, against $3,000 gain. An honest agent pays one bond, does one task per epoch, and earns undiluted rewards, like a tundra outpost on supply runs.
